newsitem.title: INDIA: OPINION-WEEKLY TECHNICAL ANALYSIS OF BOMBAY SHARE INDEX.
newsitem.headline: OPINION-WEEKLY TECHNICAL ANALYSIS OF BOMBAY SHARE INDEX.

text.p: SENSEX TURNS BULLISH BUT WEAK FOR NOW is a trend analysis of the 30-share Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) index for the period January 20 to January 24 by analyst Mehmood Khan at Times Guaranty Financials Ltd

Trading for the week ended on a cautious, with a gain of 4.03 points (0.12 percent) at 3422.35 levels over the previous week, with an intra-week high of 3812.31. The top coincides with the budget day top of 3812 on July 22, 1996. The interim break (3812.31) was at the 2x1 (26.25 deg.) Gann fan lines drawn by taking 390 (March 28, 1988) as the bottom. At 3812.31 levels the Sensex has retraced, the decline of 1418.10 points (4131.22 - 2713.12) by 77.51 percent, which is quite close to Gann's vital retracement level of 80 percent (3847.60).

The intermediate trend can be classified to be up, the minor trend which is down may find support at 3305-3205 levels with a stop loss of 3185. The ongoing correction may retrace the rally of 1099.19 (2713.12 - 3812.31) by 50 to 61.8 percent. The Gann grid lines depicts support to emerge at 3305, 3242 and 3207 levels.

The Fibonacci Arc drawn by taking 3812.31 as the top and 2713.12 as the bottom, outlines the 1st Arc support at 3392, 2nd Arc at 3263 and 3rd Arc at 3133 levels. Another vital retracement theory is calculating the retracement by multiplying the Top by the Fibonacci numbers. The 13 percent erosion from 3812.31 works out to 3316.71 and the 21 percent is 3011.72. The Sensex may find support in between the two retracement levels.

The speed of the current rise has been at the rate of 39.26 points per trading day as compared to the decline from 4131.22 to 2713.12, at the rate of 11.72 points per trading day. The internal extension of the rise has been 100 percent and the external extension hovering at 78 percent justifies the intermediate trend to be up.

The cycle theory depicts the minor correction may last till the last week of January. The Change in Trend (CIT) is due and may occur on 27th/31st January 1997. The mechanical oscillators in conjunction with the volume justify that the minor bottom may be formed at 3305-3205. The 200 days moving average is 3311.85 and the 200 weeks average is 3201.40 levels.

The price following oscillators on the weekly bar chart are exhibiting that a bottom may be formed at 3315-3242 levels- Relative Strength Index (14 RSI) is 56.40, Price Rate of Change (12 ROC) is placed at -9.33, short term stochastic is hovering at 81.64 and its trigger line is at 78.09, while the medium term stochastic is 65.91 and the trigger is 53.54, the Macd is -60.68 and its trigger is -105.18, the price oscillator is 4.29 & the 14 William's percent R is placed at -35.48.

For the current week, the BSE Sensex in the upmove may encounter resistance at 3446.28 and 3485 levels, on the lower end it may find support at 3315, 3263 and at the 200 weeks average at 3207 level. The National Index may witness profit booking at 1532-1549 level and support at 1480 and 1439 level.
(The opinions expressed in this article reflect the views of the author only. They should not be taken as reflecting the views of Reuters)
